subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram-owned agent-facing surface should expose known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: an observed topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver, or context injection?
rationale: Current code has an id-to-name cache, but reversing it for routing needs maintainer intent for stale data, duplicate titles, closed topics, permissions, and whether the contract belongs in message actions, session context, or metadata.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Direct Resolver
options.body: Add a name-to-id helper that returns structured ambiguity or stale-data errors instead of silently routing when multiple or old matches exist.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs Only
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the supported routing contract and document the workaround until a stronger product surface is chosen.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent topic-name source work and Telegram action-surface commits that would likely anchor a resolver or catalog contract.
